entities.name: Interstate Commerce Commission
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The first independent regulatory agency in the United States (1887-1995), created to regulate railroad rates and prevent monopolistic practices. The ICC established the model for independent regulatory commissions — combining quasi-legislative, quasi-executive, and quasi-judicial functions — that would be replicated across American government and worldwide.
